data.title: Home
data.hero_heading: Got something you want to make happen?
data.hero_body: An idea you can’t shake. A problem worth solving. A business you want to move forward. Find good people, fresh perspectives and a practical next step.
data.inspiration_heading: A little inspiration. A lot of possibility.
data.audience_heading: For people with a bit of fire.
data.audience_body: You might run a café, work from home, support a charity, or have an idea that hasn’t found its feet yet. If you want to solve a problem or make something happen, you’re welcome here.
data.about_body: I’m a Teesside-based thinking partner and problem solver. I help people make sense of complicated things, use technology well, and build the confidence to take ideas forward.
data.cta_body: Leave your email to hear about the first gathering and help shape what comes next.
